evidence: Measured stationary controls under declared audio-DMA and inbound USB load
transformation: Original USB wire bytes, complete window, gzip with mtime=0. Scope times relative to first application service edge; 10 ms analog medians rounded to six decimals; metadata copied only from explicit allowlist.

analog.note: 10 ms block medians rounded to six decimals; not calibrated voltage accuracy.

limits: One fixture and bounded stationary run. Callback timing excludes SDK conversion and IRQ overhead; padding is synthetic occupancy, not production DSP or audio-quality qualification. Host USB pacing is best effort. No calibrated voltage, rail/brownout, jack-detection or universal timing claim. Native originals retained privately; published scope data are derived subsets. Declared quality failures remain failures.
